exact_semantics: Each actual header is data +00, signed count +04, and signed capacity +08; pointees are never read or destroyed.
The three fastcall resize adapters reserve EDX explicitly and forward the stacked signed count to the published raw 00737390 provider.
Growth reloads the current base for each slot, writes zero only through a nonnull computed slot, and does not publish count until the final store.
Shrink repeatedly decrements the current count and then publishes the requested count; removed cells retain their prior bits.
Each destructor performs resize-to-zero first, then loads and frees CURRENT data, preserving stale data and capacity bits.
Negative capacity may allocate one cell during resize-to-zero; final free therefore uses the replacement pointer.
Provider or resize failure propagates before later stores or final free; no fallback, rollback, or extra cleanup is added.
